acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-01: Opening `http://localhost:5173` shows the TODO items loaded from the API, and an empty-state message when there are none.

verification.definingInputProperty: An item seeded through the API, and an API returning an empty list
verification.assertions: The seeded item renders on load; the empty-state message renders for an empty list

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-02: Entering a title (and optional notes) and pressing Add creates the item through the API and shows it without a page reload, and the Add button is disabled while the title is blank.

verification.definingInputProperty: A blank and whitespace-only title, then a real title with notes
verification.assertions: Add stays disabled for blank input; the item appears with its notes; inputs clear; no navigation occurs; exactly one POST created

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-03: Ticking an item's checkbox marks it completed and shows it struck through, unticking marks it active, and both persist through the API.

verification.definingInputProperty: A new item toggled on, reloaded, toggled off, reloaded
verification.assertions: Checked and struck through after completing, unchecked and not struck through after reopening, both surviving reloads

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-04: Editing an item's title or notes and pressing Save persists the change, while Cancel or the Escape key discards it.

verification.definingInputProperty: An edit discarded with Cancel, one discarded with Escape, and one saved
verification.assertions: Discarded text never appears; saved title and notes persist across reload and the old title is gone

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-05: Deleting an item removes it from the list once the API confirms the delete.

verification.definingInputProperty: An item deleted through its delete button
verification.assertions: DELETE returns 204, then the row disappears and stays gone after reload

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-06: The All, Active, and Completed filters show the matching items, and a counter shows how many items are still active.

verification.definingInputProperty: One completed and one active item under each filter
verification.assertions: Active, Completed, and All show exactly the matching items; URL carries the filter; the counter drops by one when an item completes

verification.definingInputProperty: Mixed completed/active lists, empty lists, and invalid filter values
verification.assertions: Filters select the right items in order; the count is correct; unknown filters fall back to all

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-07: When an API call fails, the page shows a readable error message instead of failing silently.

verification.definingInputProperty: A POST that fails at the network level, and a PATCH on an item deleted elsewhere
verification.assertions: An alert shows the network message and can be dismissed; a not-found alert shows and the stale row disappears

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-08: All user-facing text, including aria-labels and placeholders, comes from i18next translation keys, and every icon-only button has an aria-label.

verification.assertions: Every t() key exists; no literal aria-label/placeholder/title; no literal JSX text; every icon-only Button has aria-label

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-09: A Playwright end-to-end test drives AC-01 through AC-06 in a real browser against the real API and database.

verification.command: pnpm test:e2e && psql postgres://todo:todo@localhost:5432/todo_test -tAc "select count(*) from todo_item" | grep -qx 0
verification.definingInputProperty: Chromium driving the real Vite app, real API, and real todo_test database
verification.assertions: All 9 e2e tests pass and every row they created is removed afterwards
